environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on Kubernetes (EKS 1.28) in namespace 'content-svc'. Pod runs as non-root user (uid 1000) but has read access to host-mounted /etc/passwd via a hostPath volume at /app/uploads/../../../etc. The container runs with default network policies (allow-all). The service is exposed via an internal ClusterIP service on port 8080 accessible from other pods in the cluster. No ingress controller filtering is applied to internal traffic.

config.pod_security: restricted PSS but with hostPath volume exception
